tool_args.rationale: The branch probe established that a stronger sink gradient lowers transfer, but the endpoint data still support both static inhibition and dynamic two-layer transfer. The trajectory batch is the only remaining relevant probe for testing that distinction before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a static saturation law with gradient inhibition
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The off-baseline gradients were each tested at a different drive. That shows inhibition but does not establish whether the gradient acts independently of drive.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a dynamic two-layer transfer law
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: All seven endpoints share the same horizon and initial state, so they do not resolve the transient response of either layer.
